mappability.scope: natural reference locus; no designed-variant mappability prediction
mappability.not_equivalent_to: paired-end ATAC alignment quality with actual read lengths and aligner settings

repeat_overlap_policy: union of clipped repeat intervals; preserve all repeat names/classes/families and edit-base context
selection_policy: annotation only; no automatic repeat or mappability exclusions
provenance_policy: first download records observed SHA256 and HTTP metadata; subsequent use verifies the saved hashes
